scope: Unmodified candidate assets at the bare root without query. Cloud Chromium mobile emulation with trusted CDP/browser touch events. Browser automation observes the actual scene draws and HUD and does not set player coordinates directly. If streetShortcut is set, the actual settings dropdown relocates the player to the public street, then native joystick travel begins there. Only the real Presence host wall time is selected. Mountain test starts within a scheduled cable approach window and can advance host time after observed cable ascent; between controlled day, dusk and bell checkpoints the real server wall advances. A diagnostic render fallback is available only if measured full skyward cadence is too slow. If used, native WASD transit samples actual render once every 8s. Full draws resume before the guard checks.
mountainScope: Bare root boot, then the actual public 火车站 settings dropdown automated via its change event. All station and mountain walking, camera input and cable request use trusted native CDP touch. Cable boarding and first ascent use normal time. When requested, the fixture advances only the live Presence wall after the measured ascent. The same production client receives that clock through its own periodic sample and performs the real disembark. Sparse rendering is limited to transit. The gate uses full rendering.
